# Nomi

> Open-source, local-first AI agent workbench with a unified 4-protocol model gateway, built on Go + Wails v3 + React (~25 MB native installer, MIT license).

- Website (EN, Default): https://withnomi.app/
- Website (ZH): https://withnomi.app/zh/
- Features: https://withnomi.app/features.html (https://withnomi.app/zh/features.html)
- Download (v2.5.3): https://withnomi.app/download.html (https://withnomi.app/zh/download.html)
- Changelog: https://withnomi.app/changelog.html (https://withnomi.app/zh/changelog.html)
- Privacy & Security: https://withnomi.app/privacy.html (https://withnomi.app/zh/privacy.html)
- Repository: https://github.com/Cookieboty/nomi-ai

## Core Capabilities
- **Parallel Agent Board**: Monitor Nomi chats, background sub-tasks, dispatched agents, and external terminal/IDE sessions (read-only) in one place, with automatic memory-pressure pause & resume.
- **Unified Workspace & Direct CLI Base**: Manage all projects and agent endpoints in one unified sidebar, and pick installed official CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) per conversation in main chat.
- **Multi-Tab Side Workspace**: Expand on demand with side-by-side Diff review, per-turn undo, run traces (graph/timeline/thinking), integrated split terminal, native embedded browser, and side chat.
- **Models & Agents + Local Unified Gateway**: Configure task & cost routing, official accounts, third-party providers (4-protocol loopback translation across Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, and Gemini generateContent), and local models (llama.cpp / Ollama) in one place; retries stay on the same model.
- **Local-First Privacy & Sandbox**: No Nomi cloud account required. Chats, memories, and knowledge-base indexes stay local; API keys are stored in OS keychain; macOS system sandbox shields SSH/Git credentials and .env files.
- **Optional Desktop Character**: Off by default on fresh installs; every workbench capability works identically with it off.

## Documentation Index
- [Docs Home (EN)](https://withnomi.app/docs.html) / [Docs Home (ZH)](https://withnomi.app/zh/docs.html)
- [Getting started](https://withnomi.app/docs/getting-started.html): Install, onboarding, open an agent session, add a model, shortcuts
- [Agents](https://withnomi.app/docs/coding-agents.html): Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI and more: accounts, providers, permission modes, side workspace, sessions
- [Agent board](https://withnomi.app/docs/agent-board.html): Who is working, how far along, memory and CPU; the memory guard pauses and resumes
- [Agent monitor](https://withnomi.app/docs/agent-monitor.html): Progress notices for local coding tools
- [Slash commands](https://withnomi.app/docs/slash-commands.html): The / palette; built-ins run in the UI, the rest go to the CLI
- [Privacy & security](https://withnomi.app/docs/privacy-security.html): Data location, local-only mode, outbound masking, prompts, export
- [Providers & models](https://withnomi.app/docs/providers.html): Assign models to chat and each agent, multiple keys, no model switch on failure
- [Local models](https://withnomi.app/docs/local-models.html): One-click small models, Ollama, offline mode
- [MCP & skills](https://withnomi.app/docs/mcp-skills.html): MCP servers, SKILL.md packs, importing from other tools
- [Automation](https://withnomi.app/docs/automation.html): Files, commands, reminders, clipboard, code sandbox, tool permissions
- [AI chat](https://withnomi.app/docs/chat.html): Unified workspace, direct CLI bases, images and files, image generation, command palette
- [Knowledge base](https://withnomi.app/docs/knowledge-base.html): Answers from your folders, with citations
- [Long-term memory](https://withnomi.app/docs/memory.html): What Nomi remembers and how to manage it
- [Schedule & tasks](https://withnomi.app/docs/scheduling.html): Reminders, jobs, proactive chat, do-not-disturb, persistent tasks
- [Desktop character](https://withnomi.app/docs/mascot.html): Optional, close it any time: actions, display, toolbar, size, settings
- [Voice](https://withnomi.app/docs/voice.html): Speech input, wake word, the character's voice
- [Dynamic Island](https://withnomi.app/docs/dynamic-island.html): Notch-style notices on macOS
- [Personalization](https://withnomi.app/docs/personalization.html): Themes, app icons, sidebar, shortcuts, language, accessibility
- [Auto-update](https://withnomi.app/docs/auto-update.html): Background download; installs in place and relaunches when you confirm
- [Character packs](https://withnomi.app/docs/character-pack.html): One complete character per build: validate, build, runtime override
- [Replacing the character](https://withnomi.app/docs/character-pack-replacing.html): For forks: new pack, validation, build, remote assets
- [Character pack contract](https://withnomi.app/docs/character-pack-contract.html): The manifest, persona and mapping schema
- [Designer checklist](https://withnomi.app/docs/character-pack-checklist.html): What to check before handing over character assets
- [Provider links](https://withnomi.app/docs/provider-link.html): The “Add to Nomi” button for relays and model platforms
- [Architecture](https://withnomi.app/docs/architecture.html): How the Go core, the Wails shell and the views fit together
- [App contract](https://withnomi.app/docs/contract.html): Procedures, events and transport between the views and the core
- [Unified gateway](https://withnomi.app/docs/gateway.html): Four protocols, routing, providers and models
- [Agent integration](https://withnomi.app/docs/dev-coding-agents.html): Plugins, session drivers, the orchestrator, permission levels
- [Security boundaries](https://withnomi.app/docs/security.html): Path grants, command review, code sandbox, network and keys
- [Building](https://withnomi.app/docs/building.html): Dev setup, packaging and running locally
- [Testing](https://withnomi.app/docs/testing.html): Unit, Go and end-to-end tests
- [CI](https://withnomi.app/docs/ci.html): Workflow triggers and retries
- [i18n](https://withnomi.app/docs/i18n.html): Rules for UI strings and translations
- [Frontend standards](https://withnomi.app/docs/frontend-standards.html): Tokens, components and styling rules
